description: Session modes, run and progress recording in localStorage, a module-level pause flag, a React hook, and pause-menu and settings UI for browser games.
rules: Pass a per-app storage namespace; the default 'game-session:v1' is shared by every app on one origin.
Every read normalizes untrusted storage data; a corrupted value degrades to defaults and never throws.
Storage failures (quota, disabled storage, SSR) are swallowed by the read and write functions.
Pause state is a module-level flag (setGameRuntimePaused), not React state; read it from a render loop with isGameRuntimePaused.
A GameSaveSlot exists only while a run is active; finishing or abandoning a run clears it and folds a GameResult into GameProgress.
The ui entry uses Tailwind utility classes and lucide-react icons; the root and react entries have no styling dependency.
